title: Catalogue delay on critical path
description: The product catalogue domain feeds the copilot knowledge index and forecasting SKU mapping; its slip directly delays both.
mitigation: Downstream teams informed of early-December forecast.
evidence: The product catalogue domain is on the critical path for at least two other initiatives

title: Customer-facing checklist blocks go-lives
description: Without the approved checklist no customer-facing GenAI use case can go live; CRM-01 and SAL-08 are waiting.
mitigation: One more drafting round; CRM-01 dry run as test case.
evidence: Customer Service Copilot (CRM-01) explicitly blocked for go-live.

title: Contract data engineers roll off 31 Oct
description: Half the contract engineering capacity leaves when the SOW ends unless the extension is approved, pushing the catalogue to January and the customer domain to Q2 2027.
mitigation: Escalate SOW extension to CFO; cross-train two internal engineers (partial cover).
evidence: two of our four contract data engineers roll off on 31 October when the current statement of work ends

title: Copilot scaled on stale knowledge content
description: The product knowledge index from the data platform has slipped; going live on the legacy SharePoint export risks wrong pricing and warranty answers.
mitigation: Hold wave 2 until the product index is live; manual refresh of top 200 articles in the interim.
evidence: Until that lands we would be scaling a copilot that answers from stale content.

title: No Responsible AI approval for go-live
description: The customer-facing GenAI checklist does not exist yet, so formal go-live approval cannot be granted.
mitigation: Escalated to sponsor; CRM-01 offered as test case for the draft checklist.
evidence: No checklist = no approval = no go-live.

title: Product data quality debt unowned
description: Legacy PIM data needs about 3 FTE from Product Management for six weeks; no business owners committed yet.
mitigation: Proposed data quality sprint awaiting sponsor decision.
evidence: The business data owners for product have not committed people to the cleanup.

title: No dedicated governance staff
description: All members are part-time, which the chair names as the main reason drafting is slow.
mitigation: Request for 1 FTE Responsible AI lead going to exec committee.
evidence: The working group has no dedicated staff — everyone is part-time.

title: Benefit blocked by customer-facing approval
description: Every proposal is fully rewritten by humans until the customer-facing checklist is approved, removing most of the time saving.
mitigation: Join CRM-01's checklist dry run.
evidence: we can't claim the €1.4M productivity benefit until it's resolved

title: Legacy warehouse licence renewal
description: If migrations are not complete by 1 March 2027 the old warehouse licence must be renewed for another year.
evidence: the old warehouse licence renews 1 March 2027 (approx €420k)

title: Unknown AI inside third-party SaaS
description: Embedded AI features in vendor software are not inventoried, so high-risk use under the EU AI Act may go unnoticed.
mitigation: Procurement to add AI questions to vendor onboarding by end November.
evidence: we don't yet have a complete inventory of AI features embedded in third-party SaaS

title: Model monitoring tooling unfunded
description: Monitoring tooling sits in the 2027 budget round; manual spreadsheets will not scale as use cases grow.
evidence: manual monitoring won't scale beyond ~10 production use cases

title: Full-range data blocked on data platform
description: Supply chain history and SKU mapping from DAT-02 have slipped, so the model cannot scale beyond the pilot category.
mitigation: Extend hand-curated mapping to 3 more categories (~45% of revenue); ask DAT-02 to prioritise the SKU mapping table.
evidence: We cannot scale beyond the pilot category with the current hand-curated mapping file.

title: Wrong product specs from stale index
description: The shared knowledge index depends on the delayed product catalogue; a wrong spec could reach a signed contract.
mitigation: Product spec sections locked to human-written content until the new index is live.
evidence: Accuracy risk on technical specs in proposals

title: Missing the S/S 2027 planning cycle
description: If go-live misses mid-January, benefits wait for the A/W cycle, deferring about €1M of working-capital benefit.
evidence: deferring most of the inventory benefit by ~6 months

title: Identity team stretched, SLA breached
description: Four people cover migration and BAU access requests; the request backlog is growing.
evidence: avg wait for access request now 3.5 days, SLA is 2

title: Responsible AI training content late
description: Content owed to the Skills Academy for the mandatory module is overdue.
evidence: we're behind on giving them content (was due 1 Oct)

title: Partner agents blocked on SSO access
description: Outsourced agents in Tallinn cannot use the copilot until partner SSO and conditional access are in place.
evidence: We also still need SSO / conditional access for the copilot web app before it can be opened to the outsourced partner agents in Tallinn

title: Agent adoption plateau
description: Some experienced agents ignore copilot suggestions, limiting handle-time gains.
mitigation: Champions network and coaching via the Skills Academy.
evidence: Some senior agents ignore suggestions.

title: Cross-customer pricing leakage
description: Retrieval could surface one customer's pricing in another customer's proposal.
mitigation: Retrieval scoped per account; red-team test in November.
evidence: the model could mix up pricing from one customer's proposal into another

title: Responsible AI module content missing
description: Governance content is a month late, so the module cannot be made mandatory; this also affects the EU AI Act AI-literacy obligation.
mitigation: Asked GOV-03 to commit to a date.
evidence: We can't make the path mandatory for all staff without it, and Legal won't let us write it ourselves.

title: Partner identity federation incompatible

mitigation: CISO to choose between partner upgrade, local guest accounts or a temporary IP-restricted exception.
evidence: the partner's own identity provider is on an old version and doesn't support the federation standard we chose

title: Named-user access grants
description: Without role-based groups from the Identity programme, access is managed per user, adding overhead and audit findings.
mitigation: Access packages from IT-07 due 30 Oct.
evidence: creating admin overhead and audit findings

title: Norway e-invoicing connector in beta

mitigation: Fallback to PDF ingestion for Norway first.
evidence: the vendor's connector is only in beta

title: Key person dependency on architect
description: Integration knowledge is concentrated in one solution architect.
mitigation: Documentation sprint in November.
evidence: one solution architect holds most integration knowledge

title: Planners distrust model forecasts
description: Planners heavily override forecasts today and may ignore the model without explanations.
mitigation: Explainability view, co-design sessions, Skills Academy champions.
evidence: Planners override forecasts heavily today.

title: 12% vendor price increase at renewal

mitigation: Procurement negotiating; alternative vendor benchmark ready.

mitigation: Firm date requested from CRM-01 by 25 Oct.
evidence: If it does, we need to rebook ~30 sessions and trainers
